info.name: American Gene Technologies Content Blogs API

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in response.

params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit response to posts published after a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_after
params.description: Limit response to posts modified after a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit response to posts published before a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_before
params.description: Limit response to posts modified before a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Sort collection by post attribute.

params.name: parent
params.description: Limit result set to items with particular parent IDs.

params.name: parent_exclude
params.description: Limit result set to all items except those of a particular parent ID.

params.name: search_columns
params.description: Array of column names to be searched.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit result set to posts with one or more specific slugs.

params.name: blog_categories
params.description: Limit result set to items with specific terms assigned in the blog_categories taxonomy.

params.name: blog_categories_exclude
params.description: Limit result set to items except those with specific terms assigned in the blog_categories taxonomy.

params.name: blog_tags
params.description: Limit result set to items with specific terms assigned in the blog_tags taxonomy.

params.name: blog_tags_exclude
params.description: Limit result set to items except those with specific terms assigned in the blog_tags taxonomy.

params.name: blog-post-hiv-tag
params.description: Limit result set to items with specific terms assigned in the blog-post-hiv-tag taxonomy.

params.name: blog-post-hiv-tag_exclude
params.description: Limit result set to items except those with specific terms assigned in the blog-post-hiv-tag taxonomy.

params.name: featured-media
params.description: Limit result set to items with specific terms assigned in the featured-media taxonomy.

params.name: featured-media_exclude
params.description: Limit result set to items except those with specific terms assigned in the featured-media taxonomy.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier for the item.

params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in response.

items.docs: Retrieve one Blogs item by its numeric WordPress post ID.
